senses.gloss: (cmp. רָתַת) [to tremble,] to be lax, lenient (cmp. רָפָה).

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> (ref. to <he>לרוח היום</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 3:8">Gen. III, 8</cite>) <he>ר׳ עליו כל שהיום וכ׳</he> the Lord was lenient to him, for the farther the day sinks, the cooler it grows, opp. <he>הקשה</he>; Yalk. ib. 27 <cite ref="T01122"><he>ריתח</he></cite> (corr. acc.). Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 1, ch. I <he>אלא שר׳ המקום על וכ׳</he> Rabad, a. Ar. (ed. <he>שריחם</he>) but the Lord had pity on Aaron.—V. <cite ref="T01120"><he>רִתּוּי</he></cite>.
